title: Initial register configuration
statement: For natural numbers $n,l,s,e,K,R,t,a$, define a register configuration with these values in registers $0$ through $5$, respectively; set registers $6$ through $10$ and register $14$ to zero, and set registers $11$ and $12$ to $t$ and $a$, respectively. Set register $13$ to zero.
